title: H0RunResult
description: One condition's result record for one H0 task run. Per HYPOTHESIS_VALIDATION_PLAN.md section 3.

condition.description: Plan section 3 fixes this enum to deterministic|scripted|self|independent. `self-review` is an additive local extension introduced by preregistration/h0-amendment-01-mut2.yaml for the exploratory review-style self-evaluator arm; the deviation is disclosed in that amendment. Additive only: no prior record is invalidated.

findingType.description: Classifies a finding for metric treatment. Only `defect` findings enter the H0 precision denominator. `observation` records a non-defect API or evidence note. `confirmation` records evidence that a behavior holds. Added additively for the contract-quality round; preregistration/h0-amendment-02-contract-quality.yaml requires it on every finding emitted by that round while preserving validation of earlier records.

note.description: Optional orchestrator annotation on the run (limitations, simplifications, honest caveats). Added 2026-07-27: every pre-existing result record already carried this field, so under `additionalProperties: false` none of them validated. Declaring it is a schema correction, not a new convention.
